llms.body:
# FantasyPros

> FantasyPros aggregates rankings, projections, advice, and tools from 100+ fantasy sports experts to help users win their leagues across NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, and daily fantasy sports.

FantasyPros combines expert consensus rankings (ECR) with personalized advice and league-syncing tools. Users can connect leagues from ESPN, Yahoo, Sleeper, CBS, and other platforms to get tailored start/sit recommendations, trade analysis, waiver pickups, and draft assistance. Premium tiers (PRO, MVP, HOF) unlock advanced tools, while a large portion of content is free.

## Core tools and rankings

- [Home](https://www.fantasypros.com/): Site entry point with featured advice, rankings, and news across sports.
- [NFL Draft Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/consensus-cheatsheets.php): Expert consensus rankings for draft leagues for every NFL position and scoring format.
- [NFL Weekly Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/rankings/half-point-ppr-rb.php): Weekly expert consensus rankings updated for each NFL week for every position and scoring format.
- [MLB Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/rankings/overall.php): Expert consensus rankings for MLB hitters and pitchers.
- [NBA Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/rankings/overall.php): Expert consensus rankings for NBA players by category and points formats.
- [NHL Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nhl/rankings/overall.php): Expert consensus rankings for NHL skaters and goalies.
- [NFL My Playbook](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/): Personalized fantasy assistant. Sync your league for start/sit, waiver, and trade advice for NFL fantasy leagues.
- [MLB My Playbook](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/myplaybook/): Custom tools and league advice along with league analysis for MLB fantasy leagues.
- [NBA My Playbook](https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/myplaybook/): Tools and advice for NBA fantasy leagues for category or points scoring across different hosts.
- [Draft Wizard](https://draftwizard.fantasypros.com/): Mock drafts, draft simulators, and live draft assistant tools.

## NFL features

- [Start/Sit Assistant](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/start-sit-assistant.php): Compare players and get a recommended starting lineup.
- [Who Should I Start?](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/start/): Start sit advice via a player comparison tool.
- [Trade Analyzer](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/trade-analyzer.php): Evaluate trade offers based on expert rankings.
- [Waiver Wire Assistant](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/myplaybook/waiver-wire-analyzer.php): Personalized weekly waiver pickup recommendations.
- [NFL Projections](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/projections/qb.php): Draft, weekly, and rest-of-season fantasy projections.
- [NFL Stats](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/stats/qb.php): Player stats with fantasy-relevant filters and scoring formats.
- [NFL Schedule](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/strength-of-schedule.php): Full NFL schedule with strength-of-schedule grades.
- [NFL Depth Charts](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/depth-charts.php): Team depth charts updated for fantasy relevance.
- [NFL News](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/player-news.php): Latest player news with fantasy impact analysis.
- [Gameday Live](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/gameday/): Live scoring, win probability, and lineup tracker on game day.

## MLB features

- [MLB Projections](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/projections/hitters.php): Draft, daily, and rest-of-season fantasy baseball projections.
- [MLB DFS Lineup Optimizer](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/mlb/lineup-optimizer.php): DraftKings and FanDuel lineup builder for MLB.
- [MLB Player Statistics](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/stats/hitters.php): Statistics for MLB players updated daily.
- [MLB Closer Depth Chart](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/closer-depth-chart.php): Closer and bullpen role tracker.
- [MLB Start/Sit](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/start/): Daily start/sit recommendations for MLB fantasy.
- [MLB News](https://www.fantasypros.com/mlb/player-news.php): Latest player news with fantasy impact analysis.

## NBA features

- [NBA Projections](https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/projections/overall.php): Daily and weekly NBA fantasy projections.
- [NBA DFS Lineup Optimizer](https://www.fantasypros.com/daily-fantasy/nba/lineup-optimizer.php): DraftKings and FanDuel NBA lineup builder.
- [NBA Start/Sit](https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/start/): Daily start/sit recommendations for NBA fantasy.
- [NBA News](https://www.fantasypros.com/nba/player-news.php): Latest player news with fantasy impact analysis.

## NHL features

- [NHL Rest-of-Season Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nhl/rankings/): Draft and rest-of-season NHL fantasy rankings.
- [NHL ADP](https://www.fantasypros.com/nhl/adp/overall.php): Average Draft Position for NHL fantasy players.
- [NHL News](https://www.fantasypros.com/nhl/player-news.php): Latest player news with fantasy impact analysis.

## For AI agents and developers

- [FantasyPros MCP Server](https://www.fantasypros.com/mcp/): Connect an AI assistant to rankings, projections, news and My Playbook league tools over MCP. Server URL and setup steps for each client.
- [FantasyPros Public API](https://www.fantasypros.com/api-data/): REST API for rankings, projections, player news and injuries. How to request an API key.
- [Public API Reference](https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/docs): OpenAPI documentation with a live request tester.

## Betting

- [BettingPros](https://www.bettingpros.com/): Sister site for sports betting picks, odds comparison, and props research.

## Account and subscriptions

- [Sign Up / Log In](https://www.fantasypros.com/accounts/signup/): User account creation, login, and league syncing.
- [Pricing](https://www.fantasypros.com/premium/plans/): Subscription tiers: PRO, MVP, and HOF.

## About

- [About FantasyPros](https://www.fantasypros.com/about/): Company overview and expert network details.
- [Experts](https://www.fantasypros.com/experts/nfl/): Browse the 100+ ranked experts whose rankings power consensus.
- [Accuracy Rankings](https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/accuracy/): Historical accuracy scores for each ranked expert.
- [Contact](https://www.fantasypros.com/about/contact/): Support and contact information.

## Optional

- [Affiliate Program](https://www.fantasypros.com/affiliate/): Partner and affiliate information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.fantasypros.com/about/privacy/): Data and privacy practices.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.fantasypros.com/about/legal/): Site terms of service.

        function handleSkipNavClick() {
            const customSkipContainerId = 'skip-nav-to-this-content';
            const customSkipContainerEl = document.getElementById(customSkipContainerId);

            if(customSkipContainerEl) {
                window.location.hash = `#${customSkipContainerId}`;

            }

        function removeTopBannerElements() {
            var bannerElementsToRemove = document.querySelectorAll('#ticker-bar, #banner-styles, #banner-home-styles');
            if (bannerElementsToRemove && bannerElementsToRemove.length) {
                bannerElementsToRemove.forEach(function(elem) {
                    elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);
                });
            }
            document.body.classList.remove('fp-has-top-ticker');
        }

        let showTopTicker = FP.readCookie('fp-ticker-dismissed') !== 'true';
        let showPromoBar = false;
        let showAlertBanner = false;

        let alertBannerIds = [];
                let allAlertBannerIds = [];
        if (Array.isArray(allAlertBannerIds)) {
            allAlertBannerIds.forEach(tickerId => {
                if (!FP.readCookie(`fp-alert-ticker-dismissed-${tickerId}`)) {
                    alertBannerIds.push(tickerId);
                }
            });

            // Show banner if any alert banners exist, even if promo banner has been dismissed
            if (alertBannerIds.length) {
                showAlertBanner = true;
            }
        }
        
        if (showTopTicker || showAlertBanner) {
            var tickerData = {"policy":{"type":"basic","site":"FP","target":[""],"content":[{"top":true,"text":"","short_text":""}],"top":{"weight":1,"start":1,"end":1}}};
                        // policy ticker isn't needed
            if (FP.readCookie('fp_policy') || FP.readCookie('fptoken')) {
                if ('policy' in tickerData) {
                    delete tickerData['policy'];
                }

                // if no TOS banner or alert banner, don't show top banner
                if (!showAlertBanner) {
                    showTopTicker = false;
                }
            }
            // building ticker topbar
            const topTickers = Object.keys(window.tickerData).filter(key => {
                const ticker = window.tickerData[key];

                if (!ticker.top) return false;
                return ticker.top.weight > 0 || (ticker.alert && alertBannerIds.includes(key));
            });
            if (Object.keys(topTickers).length > 0 && showTopTicker) {

                let top_banner_html = "";
                let banner_class = '';
                let before_skip = false;
                // Setup policy ticker
                if (!FP.readCookie('fp_policy') && !FP.readCookie('fptoken')) {
                    banner_class = ' top-banner__wrapper--policy';
                    before_skip = true;
                } else {
                    banner_class = alertBannerIds.length ? ' top-banner__wrapper--alert' : '';
                }
                // CLS: styles are inlined in the head (h_open.php); only inject as a
                // fallback if that inline block is missing.
                if (!document.getElementById('banner-styles')) {
                    let firstjs = document.getElementsByTagName("body")[0];
                    let top_banner = document.createElement("link");
                    top_banner.type = "text/css";
                    top_banner.rel = "stylesheet";
                    top_banner.href = "//cdn.fantasypros.com/assets/css/min/top-banner-88fe25328af952f200f55511a34762b1.css";
                    top_banner.id = "banner-styles";
                    firstjs.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner, firstjs);
                }

                // Gate class for the layout offsets in top-banner.css (inlined in head).
                // Added during parse, before first paint, so nothing shifts.
                document.body.classList.add('fp-has-top-ticker');

                let skip_link = document.getElementById('skip-to-main-content');
                let top_banner_div = document.createElement("div");
                top_banner_div.innerHTML = top_banner_html;
                top_banner_div.className = 'top-banner__wrapper js-top-banner'+banner_class;
                top_banner_div.id = 'ticker-bar';
                top_banner_div.setAttribute('role', 'region');
                top_banner_div.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'top-banner-label');
                if (before_skip) {
                    skip_link.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner_div, skip_link);
                } else {
                    skip_link.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner_div, skip_link.nextSibling);
                }
            } else if (Object.keys(topTickers).length > 0) {
                showPromoBar = true;
            }
        }
    </script>

function stickyScrollHeader() {
    if (window.innerWidth >= 500) return;

    // :visible has no vanilla equivalent — filter to elements with dimensions
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll').forEach((el) => {
        if (el.offsetParent === null) return; // hidden

        const rows = el.querySelectorAll('table thead tr');
        if (!rows.length) return;
        const newTr = rows[rows.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
        newTr.classList.add('sticky-table-header');

        const bodyRows = el.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
        if (!bodyRows.length) return;
        const lastTr = bodyRows[bodyRows.length - 1];
        const lastTds = lastTr.querySelectorAll('td');
        const newThs = newTr.querySelectorAll('th');
        for (let i = 0; i < lastTds.length; i++) {
            if (newThs[i]) {
                newThs[i].style.width = (lastTds[i].offsetWidth + 1) + 'px';
            }
        }

        const thead = el.querySelector('table thead');
        if (thead) thead.appendChild(newTr);

        const headerHeight = newTr.offsetHeight;

        const leftCover = document.createElement('div');
        leftCover.className = 'left-head-cover';
        leftCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(leftCover);

        const rightCover = document.createElement('div');
        rightCover.className = 'right-head-cover';
        rightCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(rightCover);
    });

    function checkTableScroll() {
        const tbl = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
        if (!tbl || tbl.offsetParent === null) return;

        const rect = tbl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
        const offsetTop = rect.top + scrollTop;
        if (scrollTop > offsetTop && scrollTop < offsetTop + tbl.offsetHeight) {
            tbl.classList.add('mobile-sticky-header');
        } else {
            tbl.classList.remove('mobile-sticky-header');
        }

        const stickyRow = document.querySelector('.mobile-sticky-header tr.sticky-table-header');
        if (stickyRow) {
            const scrollLeft = tbl.scrollLeft;
            stickyRow.style.left = scrollLeft > 0 ? '-' + (scrollLeft - 10) + 'px' : '10px';
        }
    }

    const scrollTable = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
    if (scrollTable) {
        scrollTable.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
}

<script type="text/javascript">
function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal.in').forEach((modal) => {
        // Dispatch hide.bs.modal event (before hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hide.bs.modal'));

        // Remove listeners to prevent stacking
        if (modal._closeHandlers) {
            modal.removeEventListener(modal._closeHandlers.eventType, modal._closeHandlers.handler);
            modal.removeEventListener('keyup', modal._closeHandlers.keyup);
            delete modal._closeHandlers;
        }

        // Hide modal
        modal.classList.remove('in');
        modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        modal.style.display = 'none';

        // Dispatch hidden.bs.modal event (after hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hidden.bs.modal'));
    });

    // Remove backdrops
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach((el) => {
        el.remove();
    });
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
}

function openModal(modalSelector, triggerEvent) {
    if (!modalSelector) return;

    const modal = document.querySelector(modalSelector);
    if (!modal) return;

    // Dispatch show.bs.modal event (before showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show.bs.modal'));

    // Show modal + backdrop
    modal.classList.add('in');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.style.display = 'block';
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');

    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop fade in';
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    // Click-outside and ESC close (avoid stacking with named functions)
    const dialog = modal.querySelector('.modal-dialog');
    const onClickOutside = (evt) => {
        if (dialog && !dialog.contains(evt.target)) {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };
    const onEsc = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };

    // Store handlers on modal for cleanup (track eventType for correct removal)
    const eventType = (!triggerEvent || triggerEvent.type === 'click') ? 'click' : 'touchstart';
    modal._closeHandlers = { eventType: eventType, handler: onClickOutside, keyup: onEsc };

    modal.addEventListener(eventType, onClickOutside);
    modal.addEventListener('keyup', onEsc);

    // Focus the modal so keyboard events (ESC) work
    if (!modal.getAttribute('tabindex')) {
        modal.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
    modal.focus();

    // Dispatch shown.bs.modal event (after showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shown.bs.modal'));
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // Modal toggle triggers
    const modalToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle="modal"]');
    modalToggles.forEach((toggle) => {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
            evt.preventDefault();
            // Check data-target first, then fall back to href
            const modalTarget = toggle.getAttribute('data-target') || toggle.getAttribute('href');
            if (!modalTarget) return;

            openModal(modalTarget, evt);
        });
    });

    // Modal close buttons
    const modalCloses = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dismiss="modal"]');
    modalCloses.forEach((closeModal) => {
        closeModal.addEventListener("click", () => {
            closeAllModals();
        });
    });

    // Bootstrap tab toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const tabLink = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="tab"]');
        if (!tabLink) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const targetSelector = tabLink.getAttribute('data-target') || tabLink.getAttribute('href');
        if (!targetSelector) return;

        // Deactivate sibling tabs and panes
        const tabList = tabLink.closest('ul');
        if (tabList) {
            tabList.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('active'));
            const parentLi = tabLink.closest('li');
            if (parentLi) parentLi.classList.add('active');
        }

        // Show target pane, hide siblings
        const targetPane = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
        if (targetPane) {
            const tabContent = targetPane.parentElement;
            if (tabContent) {
                tabContent.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(pane => {
                    pane.classList.remove('active', 'in');
                });
            }
            targetPane.classList.add('active', 'in');
        }
    });

    // Bootstrap dropdown toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const toggle = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="dropdown"]');
        if (toggle) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const parent = toggle.closest('.btn-group, .dropdown');
            if (parent) {
                const wasOpen = parent.classList.contains('open');
                // Close all open dropdowns first
                document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                if (!wasOpen) parent.classList.add('open');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdown on menu item click (matches BS3 behavior)
        const menuItem = e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu a, .dropdown-menu button');
        if (menuItem) {
            const openParent = menuItem.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open');
            if (openParent) openParent.classList.remove('open');
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdowns when clicking outside
        if (!e.target.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
        }
    });
});

                    const oneTrustGeo = window.OneTrust?.getGeolocationData();
                    const fpGdpr = FP?.readCookie('fpisgdpr');
                    const fpState = FP?.readCookie('fpdefloc');

                    // getGeolocationData() returns an ISO country code ('DE'), never 'EU',

                        geoInfo.isGDPR = true;
                    }
                    if (fpState === 'CA' || (oneTrustGeo?.state === 'CA' && oneTrustGeo?.country === 'US')) {
                        geoInfo.isCCPA = true;
                    }

                    if (!groupsToCheck || !groupsToCheck.length) return;

    if (window.fpBrazeReady()) {
      try { window.braze.wipeData(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    clearResidue();
    clearCampaignState();
    started = false;
    pendingUuid = null;
  };

    const anchor = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (!anchor) return;
    try {
      if (new URL(anchor.href, window.location.href).pathname.indexOf('/accounts/signout') === 0) {
        window.fpBrazeWipe();
      }
    } catch (error) {}
  }, true);

  awaitConsent();

function stickyScrollHeader() {
    if (window.innerWidth >= 500) return;

    // :visible has no vanilla equivalent — filter to elements with dimensions
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll').forEach((el) => {
        if (el.offsetParent === null) return; // hidden

        const rows = el.querySelectorAll('table thead tr');
        if (!rows.length) return;
        const newTr = rows[rows.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
        newTr.classList.add('sticky-table-header');

        const bodyRows = el.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
        if (!bodyRows.length) return;
        const lastTr = bodyRows[bodyRows.length - 1];
        const lastTds = lastTr.querySelectorAll('td');
        const newThs = newTr.querySelectorAll('th');
        for (let i = 0; i < lastTds.length; i++) {
            if (newThs[i]) {
                newThs[i].style.width = (lastTds[i].offsetWidth + 1) + 'px';
            }
        }

        const thead = el.querySelector('table thead');
        if (thead) thead.appendChild(newTr);

        const headerHeight = newTr.offsetHeight;

        const leftCover = document.createElement('div');
        leftCover.className = 'left-head-cover';
        leftCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(leftCover);

        const rightCover = document.createElement('div');
        rightCover.className = 'right-head-cover';
        rightCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(rightCover);
    });

    function checkTableScroll() {
        const tbl = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
        if (!tbl || tbl.offsetParent === null) return;

        const rect = tbl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
        const offsetTop = rect.top + scrollTop;
        if (scrollTop > offsetTop && scrollTop < offsetTop + tbl.offsetHeight) {
            tbl.classList.add('mobile-sticky-header');
        } else {
            tbl.classList.remove('mobile-sticky-header');
        }

        const stickyRow = document.querySelector('.mobile-sticky-header tr.sticky-table-header');
        if (stickyRow) {
            const scrollLeft = tbl.scrollLeft;
            stickyRow.style.left = scrollLeft > 0 ? '-' + (scrollLeft - 10) + 'px' : '10px';
        }
    }

    const scrollTable = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
    if (scrollTable) {
        scrollTable.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
}

function generateTableCaption(container, text) {
    var tableContainer = container || document.getElementById('main-container') || document.getElementById('sport-landing-page-app');
    if (!tableContainer) return;

    var captionText = text || document.title;
    var tables = tableContainer.getElementsByTagName('table');
    const len = tables.length;

    for (var i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        var table = tables[i];
        var captions = table.getElementsByTagName('caption');
        if (captions.length === 0) {
            var caption = document.createElement('caption');
            caption.className = 'hidden-aria';
            caption.textContent = captionText;
            table.insertBefore(caption, table.childNodes[0]);
            break;
        }
    }
}

<script type="text/javascript">
function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal.in').forEach((modal) => {
        // Dispatch hide.bs.modal event (before hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hide.bs.modal'));

        // Remove listeners to prevent stacking
        if (modal._closeHandlers) {
            modal.removeEventListener(modal._closeHandlers.eventType, modal._closeHandlers.handler);
            modal.removeEventListener('keyup', modal._closeHandlers.keyup);
            delete modal._closeHandlers;
        }

        // Hide modal
        modal.classList.remove('in');
        modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        modal.style.display = 'none';

        // Dispatch hidden.bs.modal event (after hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hidden.bs.modal'));
    });

    // Remove backdrops
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach((el) => {
        el.remove();
    });
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
}

function openModal(modalSelector, triggerEvent) {
    if (!modalSelector) return;

    const modal = document.querySelector(modalSelector);
    if (!modal) return;

    // Dispatch show.bs.modal event (before showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show.bs.modal'));

    // Show modal + backdrop
    modal.classList.add('in');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.style.display = 'block';
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');

    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop fade in';
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    // Click-outside and ESC close (avoid stacking with named functions)
    const dialog = modal.querySelector('.modal-dialog');
    const onClickOutside = (evt) => {
        if (dialog && !dialog.contains(evt.target)) {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };
    const onEsc = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };

    // Store handlers on modal for cleanup (track eventType for correct removal)
    const eventType = (!triggerEvent || triggerEvent.type === 'click') ? 'click' : 'touchstart';
    modal._closeHandlers = { eventType: eventType, handler: onClickOutside, keyup: onEsc };

    modal.addEventListener(eventType, onClickOutside);
    modal.addEventListener('keyup', onEsc);

    // Focus the modal so keyboard events (ESC) work
    if (!modal.getAttribute('tabindex')) {
        modal.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
    modal.focus();

    // Dispatch shown.bs.modal event (after showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shown.bs.modal'));
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // Modal toggle triggers
    const modalToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle="modal"]');
    modalToggles.forEach((toggle) => {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
            evt.preventDefault();
            // Check data-target first, then fall back to href
            const modalTarget = toggle.getAttribute('data-target') || toggle.getAttribute('href');
            if (!modalTarget) return;

            openModal(modalTarget, evt);
        });
    });

    // Modal close buttons
    const modalCloses = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dismiss="modal"]');
    modalCloses.forEach((closeModal) => {
        closeModal.addEventListener("click", () => {
            closeAllModals();
        });
    });

    // Bootstrap tab toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const tabLink = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="tab"]');
        if (!tabLink) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const targetSelector = tabLink.getAttribute('data-target') || tabLink.getAttribute('href');
        if (!targetSelector) return;

        // Deactivate sibling tabs and panes
        const tabList = tabLink.closest('ul');
        if (tabList) {
            tabList.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('active'));
            const parentLi = tabLink.closest('li');
            if (parentLi) parentLi.classList.add('active');
        }

        // Show target pane, hide siblings
        const targetPane = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
        if (targetPane) {
            const tabContent = targetPane.parentElement;
            if (tabContent) {
                tabContent.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(pane => {
                    pane.classList.remove('active', 'in');
                });
            }
            targetPane.classList.add('active', 'in');
        }
    });

    // Bootstrap dropdown toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const toggle = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="dropdown"]');
        if (toggle) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const parent = toggle.closest('.btn-group, .dropdown');
            if (parent) {
                const wasOpen = parent.classList.contains('open');
                // Close all open dropdowns first
                document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                if (!wasOpen) parent.classList.add('open');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdown on menu item click (matches BS3 behavior)
        const menuItem = e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu a, .dropdown-menu button');
        if (menuItem) {
            const openParent = menuItem.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open');
            if (openParent) openParent.classList.remove('open');
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdowns when clicking outside
        if (!e.target.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
        }
    });
});

            var bannerElementsToRemove = document.querySelectorAll('#ticker-bar, #banner-styles, #banner-home-styles');
            if (bannerElementsToRemove && bannerElementsToRemove.length) {
                bannerElementsToRemove.forEach(function(elem) {
                    elem.parentNode.removeChild(elem);
                });
            }
            document.body.classList.remove('fp-has-top-ticker');
        }

        let showTopTicker = FP.readCookie('fp-ticker-dismissed') !== 'true';
        let showPromoBar = false;
        let showAlertBanner = false;

        let alertBannerIds = [];
                let allAlertBannerIds = [];
        if (Array.isArray(allAlertBannerIds)) {
            allAlertBannerIds.forEach(tickerId => {
                if (!FP.readCookie(`fp-alert-ticker-dismissed-${tickerId}`)) {
                    alertBannerIds.push(tickerId);
                }
            });

            // Show banner if any alert banners exist, even if promo banner has been dismissed
            if (alertBannerIds.length) {
                showAlertBanner = true;
            }
        }
        
        if (showTopTicker || showAlertBanner) {
            var tickerData = {"policy":{"type":"basic","site":"FP","target":[""],"content":[{"top":true,"text":"","short_text":""}],"top":{"weight":1,"start":1,"end":1}}};
                        // policy ticker isn't needed
            if (FP.readCookie('fp_policy') || FP.readCookie('fptoken')) {
                if ('policy' in tickerData) {
                    delete tickerData['policy'];
                }

                // if no TOS banner or alert banner, don't show top banner
                if (!showAlertBanner) {
                    showTopTicker = false;
                }
            }
            // building ticker topbar
            const topTickers = Object.keys(window.tickerData).filter(key => {
                const ticker = window.tickerData[key];

                if (!ticker.top) return false;
                return ticker.top.weight > 0 || (ticker.alert && alertBannerIds.includes(key));
            });
            if (Object.keys(topTickers).length > 0 && showTopTicker) {

                let top_banner_html = "";
                let banner_class = '';
                let before_skip = false;
                // Setup policy ticker
                if (!FP.readCookie('fp_policy') && !FP.readCookie('fptoken')) {
                    banner_class = ' top-banner__wrapper--policy';
                    before_skip = true;
                } else {
                    banner_class = alertBannerIds.length ? ' top-banner__wrapper--alert' : '';
                }
                // CLS: styles are inlined in the head (h_open.php); only inject as a
                // fallback if that inline block is missing.
                if (!document.getElementById('banner-styles')) {
                    let firstjs = document.getElementsByTagName("body")[0];
                    let top_banner = document.createElement("link");
                    top_banner.type = "text/css";
                    top_banner.rel = "stylesheet";
                    top_banner.href = "//cdn.fantasypros.com/assets/css/min/top-banner-88fe25328af952f200f55511a34762b1.css";
                    top_banner.id = "banner-styles";
                    firstjs.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner, firstjs);
                }

                // Gate class for the layout offsets in top-banner.css (inlined in head).
                // Added during parse, before first paint, so nothing shifts.
                document.body.classList.add('fp-has-top-ticker');

                let skip_link = document.getElementById('skip-to-main-content');
                let top_banner_div = document.createElement("div");
                top_banner_div.innerHTML = top_banner_html;
                top_banner_div.className = 'top-banner__wrapper js-top-banner'+banner_class;
                top_banner_div.id = 'ticker-bar';
                top_banner_div.setAttribute('role', 'region');
                top_banner_div.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'top-banner-label');
                if (before_skip) {
                    skip_link.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner_div, skip_link);
                } else {
                    skip_link.parentNode.insertBefore(top_banner_div, skip_link.nextSibling);
                }
            } else if (Object.keys(topTickers).length > 0) {
                showPromoBar = true;
            }
        }

function stickyScrollHeader() {
    if (window.innerWidth >= 500) return;

    // :visible has no vanilla equivalent — filter to elements with dimensions
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll').forEach((el) => {
        if (el.offsetParent === null) return; // hidden

        const rows = el.querySelectorAll('table thead tr');
        if (!rows.length) return;
        const newTr = rows[rows.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
        newTr.classList.add('sticky-table-header');

        const bodyRows = el.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
        if (!bodyRows.length) return;
        const lastTr = bodyRows[bodyRows.length - 1];
        const lastTds = lastTr.querySelectorAll('td');
        const newThs = newTr.querySelectorAll('th');
        for (let i = 0; i < lastTds.length; i++) {
            if (newThs[i]) {
                newThs[i].style.width = (lastTds[i].offsetWidth + 1) + 'px';
            }
        }

        const thead = el.querySelector('table thead');
        if (thead) thead.appendChild(newTr);

        const headerHeight = newTr.offsetHeight;

        const leftCover = document.createElement('div');
        leftCover.className = 'left-head-cover';
        leftCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(leftCover);

        const rightCover = document.createElement('div');
        rightCover.className = 'right-head-cover';
        rightCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(rightCover);
    });

    function checkTableScroll() {
        const tbl = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
        if (!tbl || tbl.offsetParent === null) return;

        const rect = tbl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
        const offsetTop = rect.top + scrollTop;
        if (scrollTop > offsetTop && scrollTop < offsetTop + tbl.offsetHeight) {
            tbl.classList.add('mobile-sticky-header');
        } else {
            tbl.classList.remove('mobile-sticky-header');
        }

        const stickyRow = document.querySelector('.mobile-sticky-header tr.sticky-table-header');
        if (stickyRow) {
            const scrollLeft = tbl.scrollLeft;
            stickyRow.style.left = scrollLeft > 0 ? '-' + (scrollLeft - 10) + 'px' : '10px';
        }
    }

    const scrollTable = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
    if (scrollTable) {
        scrollTable.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
}

    for (var i = 0; i < len; ++i) {

            var caption = document.createElement('caption');

            table.insertBefore(caption, table.childNodes[0]);

}

<script type="text/javascript">
function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal.in').forEach((modal) => {
        // Dispatch hide.bs.modal event (before hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hide.bs.modal'));

        // Remove listeners to prevent stacking
        if (modal._closeHandlers) {
            modal.removeEventListener(modal._closeHandlers.eventType, modal._closeHandlers.handler);
            modal.removeEventListener('keyup', modal._closeHandlers.keyup);
            delete modal._closeHandlers;
        }

        // Hide modal
        modal.classList.remove('in');
        modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        modal.style.display = 'none';

        // Dispatch hidden.bs.modal event (after hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hidden.bs.modal'));
    });

    // Remove backdrops
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach((el) => {
        el.remove();
    });
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
}

function openModal(modalSelector, triggerEvent) {
    if (!modalSelector) return;

    const modal = document.querySelector(modalSelector);
    if (!modal) return;

    // Dispatch show.bs.modal event (before showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show.bs.modal'));

    // Show modal + backdrop
    modal.classList.add('in');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.style.display = 'block';
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');

    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop fade in';
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    // Click-outside and ESC close (avoid stacking with named functions)
    const dialog = modal.querySelector('.modal-dialog');
    const onClickOutside = (evt) => {
        if (dialog && !dialog.contains(evt.target)) {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };
    const onEsc = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };

    // Store handlers on modal for cleanup (track eventType for correct removal)
    const eventType = (!triggerEvent || triggerEvent.type === 'click') ? 'click' : 'touchstart';
    modal._closeHandlers = { eventType: eventType, handler: onClickOutside, keyup: onEsc };

    modal.addEventListener(eventType, onClickOutside);
    modal.addEventListener('keyup', onEsc);

    // Focus the modal so keyboard events (ESC) work
    if (!modal.getAttribute('tabindex')) {
        modal.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
    modal.focus();

    // Dispatch shown.bs.modal event (after showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shown.bs.modal'));
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // Modal toggle triggers
    const modalToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle="modal"]');
    modalToggles.forEach((toggle) => {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
            evt.preventDefault();
            // Check data-target first, then fall back to href
            const modalTarget = toggle.getAttribute('data-target') || toggle.getAttribute('href');
            if (!modalTarget) return;

            openModal(modalTarget, evt);
        });
    });

    // Modal close buttons
    const modalCloses = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dismiss="modal"]');
    modalCloses.forEach((closeModal) => {
        closeModal.addEventListener("click", () => {
            closeAllModals();
        });
    });

    // Bootstrap tab toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const tabLink = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="tab"]');
        if (!tabLink) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const targetSelector = tabLink.getAttribute('data-target') || tabLink.getAttribute('href');
        if (!targetSelector) return;

        // Deactivate sibling tabs and panes
        const tabList = tabLink.closest('ul');
        if (tabList) {
            tabList.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('active'));
            const parentLi = tabLink.closest('li');
            if (parentLi) parentLi.classList.add('active');
        }

        // Show target pane, hide siblings
        const targetPane = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
        if (targetPane) {
            const tabContent = targetPane.parentElement;
            if (tabContent) {
                tabContent.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(pane => {
                    pane.classList.remove('active', 'in');
                });
            }
            targetPane.classList.add('active', 'in');
        }
    });

    // Bootstrap dropdown toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const toggle = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="dropdown"]');
        if (toggle) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const parent = toggle.closest('.btn-group, .dropdown');
            if (parent) {
                const wasOpen = parent.classList.contains('open');
                // Close all open dropdowns first
                document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                if (!wasOpen) parent.classList.add('open');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdown on menu item click (matches BS3 behavior)
        const menuItem = e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu a, .dropdown-menu button');
        if (menuItem) {
            const openParent = menuItem.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open');
            if (openParent) openParent.classList.remove('open');
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdowns when clicking outside
        if (!e.target.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
        }
    });
});

if (window.jQuery) {

        return this.each(function() {
            // Build a selector: prefer #id, fall back to generating a temporary id

            if (this.id) {
                selector = '#' + this.id;
            } else {
                const tempId = 'fp-modal-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
                this.id = tempId;
                selector = '#' + tempId;
            }

            if (action === 'show') {
                openModal(selector);
            } else if (action === 'hide') {
                closeAllModals();
            } else if (action === 'toggle') {
                if (this.classList.contains('in')) {
                    closeAllModals();
                } else {
                    openModal(selector);
                }
            } else {
                openModal(selector);
            }
        });
    };
}

    if (consentTimer) return;
    consentStartedAt = Date.now();
    consentSlowPolling = false;
    const tick = () => {
      subscribeToConsentChanges();
      if (consentResolved()) {
        applyConsent();
        window.clearInterval(consentTimer);
        consentTimer = null;
        return;
      }
      const elapsed = Date.now() - consentStartedAt;
      if (elapsed >= CONSENT_GIVE_UP_MS) {
        window.clearInterval(consentTimer);
        consentTimer = null;
        return;
      }
      if (elapsed >= CONSENT_TIMEOUT_MS && !consentSlowPolling) {
        window.clearInterval(consentTimer);
        consentSlowPolling = true;
        consentTimer = window.setInterval(tick, CONSENT_SLOW_POLL_MS);
      }
    };
    consentTimer = window.setInterval(tick, CONSENT_POLL_MS);
    tick();
  }

  window.fpBrazeStart = function (uuid) {
    if (!uuid || !CFG.enabled) return;
    pendingUuid = uuid;
    awaitConsent();
  };

  window.fpBrazeWipe = function () {
    if (window.fpBrazeReady()) {
      try { window.braze.wipeData(); } catch (e) {}
    }
    clearResidue();
    clearCampaignState();
    started = false;
    pendingUuid = null;
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const anchor = e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a[href]');
    if (!anchor) return;
    try {
      if (new URL(anchor.href, window.location.href).pathname.indexOf('/accounts/signout') === 0) {
        window.fpBrazeWipe();
      }
    } catch (error) {}
  }, true);

  awaitConsent();

})();

function stickyScrollHeader() {
    if (window.innerWidth >= 500) return;

    // :visible has no vanilla equivalent — filter to elements with dimensions
    document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll').forEach((el) => {
        if (el.offsetParent === null) return; // hidden

        const rows = el.querySelectorAll('table thead tr');
        if (!rows.length) return;
        const newTr = rows[rows.length - 1].cloneNode(true);
        newTr.classList.add('sticky-table-header');

        const bodyRows = el.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr');
        if (!bodyRows.length) return;
        const lastTr = bodyRows[bodyRows.length - 1];
        const lastTds = lastTr.querySelectorAll('td');
        const newThs = newTr.querySelectorAll('th');
        for (let i = 0; i < lastTds.length; i++) {
            if (newThs[i]) {
                newThs[i].style.width = (lastTds[i].offsetWidth + 1) + 'px';
            }
        }

        const thead = el.querySelector('table thead');
        if (thead) thead.appendChild(newTr);

        const headerHeight = newTr.offsetHeight;

        const leftCover = document.createElement('div');
        leftCover.className = 'left-head-cover';
        leftCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(leftCover);

        const rightCover = document.createElement('div');
        rightCover.className = 'right-head-cover';
        rightCover.style.minHeight = headerHeight + 'px';
        el.appendChild(rightCover);
    });

    function checkTableScroll() {
        const tbl = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
        if (!tbl || tbl.offsetParent === null) return;

        const rect = tbl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const scrollTop = window.scrollY;
        const offsetTop = rect.top + scrollTop;
        if (scrollTop > offsetTop && scrollTop < offsetTop + tbl.offsetHeight) {
            tbl.classList.add('mobile-sticky-header');
        } else {
            tbl.classList.remove('mobile-sticky-header');
        }

        const stickyRow = document.querySelector('.mobile-sticky-header tr.sticky-table-header');
        if (stickyRow) {
            const scrollLeft = tbl.scrollLeft;
            stickyRow.style.left = scrollLeft > 0 ? '-' + (scrollLeft - 10) + 'px' : '10px';
        }
    }

    const scrollTable = document.querySelector('.mobile-table.mobile-scroll');
    if (scrollTable) {
        scrollTable.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', checkTableScroll);
}

function generateTableCaption(container, text) {
    var tableContainer = container || document.getElementById('main-container') || document.getElementById('sport-landing-page-app');
    if (!tableContainer) return;

    var captionText = text || document.title;
    var tables = tableContainer.getElementsByTagName('table');
    const len = tables.length;

    for (var i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
        var table = tables[i];
        var captions = table.getElementsByTagName('caption');
        if (captions.length === 0) {
            var caption = document.createElement('caption');
            caption.className = 'hidden-aria';
            caption.textContent = captionText;
            table.insertBefore(caption, table.childNodes[0]);
            break;
        }
    }
}

<script type="text/javascript">
function closeAllModals() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal.in').forEach((modal) => {
        // Dispatch hide.bs.modal event (before hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hide.bs.modal'));

        // Remove listeners to prevent stacking
        if (modal._closeHandlers) {
            modal.removeEventListener(modal._closeHandlers.eventType, modal._closeHandlers.handler);
            modal.removeEventListener('keyup', modal._closeHandlers.keyup);
            delete modal._closeHandlers;
        }

        // Hide modal
        modal.classList.remove('in');
        modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
        modal.style.display = 'none';

        // Dispatch hidden.bs.modal event (after hiding)
        modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('hidden.bs.modal'));
    });

    // Remove backdrops
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-backdrop').forEach((el) => {
        el.remove();
    });
    document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');
}

function openModal(modalSelector, triggerEvent) {
    if (!modalSelector) return;

    const modal = document.querySelector(modalSelector);
    if (!modal) return;

    // Dispatch show.bs.modal event (before showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show.bs.modal'));

    // Show modal + backdrop
    modal.classList.add('in');
    modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
    modal.style.display = 'block';
    document.body.classList.add('modal-open');

    const backdrop = document.createElement('div');
    backdrop.className = 'modal-backdrop fade in';
    document.body.appendChild(backdrop);

    // Click-outside and ESC close (avoid stacking with named functions)
    const dialog = modal.querySelector('.modal-dialog');
    const onClickOutside = (evt) => {
        if (dialog && !dialog.contains(evt.target)) {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };
    const onEsc = (e) => {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            closeAllModals();
        }
    };

    // Store handlers on modal for cleanup (track eventType for correct removal)
    const eventType = (!triggerEvent || triggerEvent.type === 'click') ? 'click' : 'touchstart';
    modal._closeHandlers = { eventType: eventType, handler: onClickOutside, keyup: onEsc };

    modal.addEventListener(eventType, onClickOutside);
    modal.addEventListener('keyup', onEsc);

    // Focus the modal so keyboard events (ESC) work
    if (!modal.getAttribute('tabindex')) {
        modal.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
    }
    modal.focus();

    // Dispatch shown.bs.modal event (after showing)
    modal.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('shown.bs.modal'));
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // Modal toggle triggers
    const modalToggles = document.querySelectorAll('[data-toggle="modal"]');
    modalToggles.forEach((toggle) => {
        toggle.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
            evt.preventDefault();
            // Check data-target first, then fall back to href
            const modalTarget = toggle.getAttribute('data-target') || toggle.getAttribute('href');
            if (!modalTarget) return;

            openModal(modalTarget, evt);
        });
    });

    // Modal close buttons
    const modalCloses = document.querySelectorAll('[data-dismiss="modal"]');
    modalCloses.forEach((closeModal) => {
        closeModal.addEventListener("click", () => {
            closeAllModals();
        });
    });

    // Bootstrap tab toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const tabLink = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="tab"]');
        if (!tabLink) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        const targetSelector = tabLink.getAttribute('data-target') || tabLink.getAttribute('href');
        if (!targetSelector) return;

        // Deactivate sibling tabs and panes
        const tabList = tabLink.closest('ul');
        if (tabList) {
            tabList.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(li => li.classList.remove('active'));
            const parentLi = tabLink.closest('li');
            if (parentLi) parentLi.classList.add('active');
        }

        // Show target pane, hide siblings
        const targetPane = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
        if (targetPane) {
            const tabContent = targetPane.parentElement;
            if (tabContent) {
                tabContent.querySelectorAll('.tab-pane').forEach(pane => {
                    pane.classList.remove('active', 'in');
                });
            }
            targetPane.classList.add('active', 'in');
        }
    });

    // Bootstrap dropdown toggle (vanilla replacement)
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        const toggle = e.target.closest('[data-toggle="dropdown"]');
        if (toggle) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const parent = toggle.closest('.btn-group, .dropdown');
            if (parent) {
                const wasOpen = parent.classList.contains('open');
                // Close all open dropdowns first
                document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
                if (!wasOpen) parent.classList.add('open');
            }
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdown on menu item click (matches BS3 behavior)
        const menuItem = e.target.closest('.dropdown-menu a, .dropdown-menu button');
        if (menuItem) {
            const openParent = menuItem.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open');
            if (openParent) openParent.classList.remove('open');
            return;
        }
        // Close dropdowns when clicking outside
        if (!e.target.closest('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open')) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.btn-group.open, .dropdown.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
        }
    });
});

// jQuery bridge for backward compatibility
if (window.jQuery) {
    jQuery.fn.modal = function(action) {
        return this.each(function() {
            // Build a selector: prefer #id, fall back to generating a temporary id
            let selector;
            if (this.id) {
                selector = '#' + this.id;
            } else {
                const tempId = 'fp-modal-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9);
                this.id = tempId;
                selector = '#' + tempId;
            }

            if (action === 'show') {
                openModal(selector);
            } else if (action === 'hide') {
                closeAllModals();
            } else if (action === 'toggle') {
                if (this.classList.contains('in')) {
                    closeAllModals();
                } else {
                    openModal(selector);
                }
            } else {
                openModal(selector);
            }
        });
    };
}
</script>
